title: Demo edit deep-link still boots to an empty form — demo_entry_effects has no VacancyEdit arm (r1 W11 carry-forward)
detail: Refresh on /vacancies/v-maples/edit enters demo (is_demo_route matches VacancyEdit) but no get_for_edit is ever dispatched at boot — the form renders empty. The comment claims a response that is never requested; r2 briefing lists this fold as landed.
recommended_fix: Add a routes.VacancyEdit(id) arm to demo_entry_effects dispatching demo_api.get_for_edit(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit), and set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo for that route.

title: Reset demo still strands non-dashboard demo pages on a permanent spinner — reset_demo never navigates (r1 W13 carry-forward)
evidence:
reset_demo: "vacancy_detail: NotAsked,
          leaderboard: NotAsked,
          application_detail: NotAsked,
          comparison_details: NotAsked,
          archived_vacancies: NotAsked,
          awaiting_list: NotAsked,
          notifications: NotAsked,
          toasts: [],
        ),
        demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications)," — no modem.push, no route-data refetch. vacancy_detail.gleam:26: "NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()".
detail: The banner reset button is global chrome, but from a demo detail/archived/comparison route, reset wipes page data to NotAsked and refetches only notifications — view_loading() spins forever. r2 briefing claims 'reset navigates home' landed; it didn't.
recommended_fix: In reset_demo, also dispatch modem.push("/demo") (or refetch the current route's data from the fresh store) so no page is left NotAsked.

title: visibilitychange doc paragraph still sits on handle_browser_change; listen_visibility_refresh has no doc (r1 N27 carry-forward)
detail: r1 N27 unfixed: the extraction moved the paragraph into handle_browser_change's doc (where it is wrong) and left the listener function undocumented. Misleading for the next maintainer of the multi-tab sync.
recommended_fix: Move the visibilitychange paragraph from handle_browser_change's doc onto listen_visibility_refresh, keeping only the navigation-extraction doc on handle_browser_change.

title: Demo banner message still inlined in the view; copy.demo_banner_message is an orphaned constant (r1 W15 partial fix)
detail: The constant was added for the r1 copy fix but the view was never switched to it — the AGENTS.md copy.gleam rule is still violated for this string and the constant is dead.
recommended_fix: Replace the inline literal in demo_banner.gleam with copy.demo_banner_message.

title: Five pub demo helpers ship with zero callers (r1 N28 carry-forward)
evidence: demo_api.gleam:66 "pub fn check_session(" — grep across client/ finds no call site; demo_fixtures.gleam:127 "pub fn decode_checked(", :143 "pub fn all_fixture_jsons() -> List(#(String, String)) {", :199 "pub fn result_to_seed_error(" — no callers; demo_analytics.gleam:23 "pub fn capture_with_props(" — no callers (only capture_event is used).
detail: The r1-cited demo_api refcheck mirrors were deleted (that half is fixed), but five unused pub helpers remain across demo/ — dead code against the no-tech-debt rule, and check_session is a second source of truth for session semantics.
recommended_fix: Delete demo_api.check_session, decode_checked, all_fixture_jsons, result_to_seed_error, and capture_with_props (or wire them and drop the parallel path).

title: download_timeout and the seed-fallback store accessor duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam (r1 N31 carry-forward)
evidence: client.gleam:6844 "fn download_timeout(analysis_id: String, delay_ms: Int)" vs demo_update.gleam:730 "fn download_timeout(id: String) -> Effect(Msg) {" (its own comment: "mirrors client.gleam's `download_timeout`"); client.gleam:5872 "fn demo_store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore {" vs demo_update.gleam:617 "fn store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore {" — both with the identical seed/empty_store fallback body.
detail: r1 N31 unfixed, and the same duplication shape was added for the store accessor: two implementations each that can drift (e.g. timeout value, fallback semantics).
recommended_fix: Hoist a demo_store.or_seed(Option(DemoStore)) helper into demo_store.gleam and one shared download-timeout helper; import from both modules.

title: Demo mode still writes/reads real web storage — sweep-nudge dismissals and comparison ids persist (r1 N24 carry-forward)
evidence: UserDismissedSweepNudge arm: "save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed))" (4943, no demo branch); handle_browser_change: "save_comparison_ids([])" (5411, 5416 — unconditional, runs in demo); demo_entry_effects Comparison arm reads "load_comparison_ids()," (5848).
detail: Demo interactions persist to localStorage/sessionStorage and are read back at demo entry — contradicts the PR-body scope guard 'no persistence of any kind'; stale demo ids (a-aoife) can leak into a later real session's comparison state.
recommended_fix: Skip save/load_comparison_ids and save_dismissed_sweep_nudges when model.demo_mode, or key demo state under a demo-scoped storage key.

title: report_download_test derives analysis ids from the filename table it validates — the store-side id contract is unpinned
evidence:
report_download_test.gleam: "// pair.0 is the app id ("a-aoife"); the analysis id is "an-aoife".
    let analysis_id = "an-" <> string.drop_start(pair.0, 2)
    demo_api.application_id_from_analysis(analysis_id)
    |> should.equal(pair.0)" — while the live ids come from a separate table, demo_store.gleam:198: "\"an-aoife\"," (analysis_for).
detail: The test pins the mapping function (it can fail) but manufactures its inputs, so a fixture-side analysis-id drift (e.g. renaming an-aoife) keeps every test green while the real demo download 404s.
recommended_fix: Add an assertion that each seeded store application's ai_analysis.id round-trips: application_id_from_analysis(analysis.id) finds a key in report_filenames().
